issue.title: just check fails at lint (mypy): 9bd351b67 wait release confirmation uses pre-rename families/family_name fields
issue.description:
Found by the sase-17z land agent at master 71736697d while running `sase tool run check`.

`just check` fails at lint (mypy) with 4 errors, and ~17 wait-dependency tests fail
deterministically:

    src/sase/core/wait_dependency_resolution/_index_queries.py:482: "WaitDependencyIndexQueries" has no attribute "families"
    src/sase/core/wait_dependency_resolution/_index_queries.py:491: "ArtifactCandidate" has no attribute "family_name"
    src/sase/core/wait_dependency_resolution/_index_queries.py:493: "WaitDependencyIndexQueries" has no attribute "families"
    src/sase/axe/run_agent_wait_deps.py:65: Function is missing a return type annotation

Failing nodes include tests/test_run_agent_wait_deps.py (16),
tests/test_axe_chop_wait_checks_terminal_outcomes.py (10),
tests/test_axe_chop_wait_checks_clan.py::test_clan_wait_writes_ready_after_successful_member_is_dismissed,
and likely tests/test_axe_run_agent_failed_fork_admission.py::TestFailedForkParentAdmission::test_preflight_and_extraction_agree_on_a_failed_fork_parent.

ROOT CAUSE: 9bd351b67 (`fix(wait): confirm release membership before family handoff`, agent
0r1, 13:36) added release-confirmation queries written against the pre-rename index
fields (`self.families`, `candidate.family_name`). 7e1b05964 (`refactor(agent-session):
finish the wire cutover and land sase-17m.3.1`, 13:23) had already renamed those to the
agent-session spellings, so the new code references attributes that no longer exist.

BISECT (worktrees, same venv): tests/test_run_agent_wait_deps.py +
failed_fork_admission + prompt_panel_monitor → 3 failed at 7e1b05964^, 3 at 7e1b05964,
3 at bda83083b, 20 at 9bd351b67. The 3 pre-existing failures are the monitor-panel tests
tracked separately.

FIX: rename the new 9bd351b67 references to the agent-session index fields (and add the
missing return annotation), then rerun the wait suites above.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: mypy attr-defined errors on names removed by 7e1b05964, and the wait suites fail identically on a pristine tree and in a worktree at 9bd351b67 (20 failed) but not at its parent chain (3 failed, unrelated).
